actions.reason: The K5_C0001-K5_C0005 boundary is the weakest reviewed: independent two-way spectral ARI is 0.044, normalized-cut cost is high (0.904) with elevated between-side affinity (0.230), and the union eigengap is strongly single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.733), a coherent merge-compatible pattern. Native-view geometry agrees that the boundary is not coherently expressed (CT, RNA, WXS near-zero; only WSI modest). K5_C0005 also lacks a defensible independent identity: no driver gene survives correction and its phenotype is weak/imprecise (n=4). The union is more consistent with a single unit than with two independently represented sets.
